portfolio_boundary: Noetfield product/asset until proven separate legal entity
north_star: Real people completing a meaningful first reflection, inviting someone voluntarily and returning for another useful experience

metrics_units.engaged_browsers: browser identifiers that submitted first quiz answer
metrics_units.verified_volunteers: people with source-backed voluntary feedback or confirmed real participation
metrics_units.actual_users: never infer from HTTP requests or bot traffic

principle: Free meaningful first value before account, no payment and no wallet

distribution_policy.outbound_email: operations@noetfield.com until MIRRA alias is actually configured
distribution_policy.consent: explicit per MIRRA project, do not reuse cross-venture

safety_and_truth.psychometrics: IPIP scoring separate from exploratory quizzes

cadence.observer: existing Launch Factory 30 minute GitHub workflow
cadence.goal: keep source grounded next action populated on each cycle
cadence.fact: scheduled observer is not proof of AI code worker commissioning

roles.name: Competitor & Audience Intelligence
roles.system: SourceA / existing research model via Company OS
roles.scope: Recheck competitor product evidence, public community pain points, differentiation and licensing. Rank hypotheses; avoid scraped PII.

roles.name: Psychometrics & Content Quality
roles.scope: Audit IPIP scoring, source attribution, nonclinical wording, cultural readability and scenario quality. No diagnosis, no invented validity.

roles.name: Editorial Product and Accessibility
roles.system: Existing project engineering worker via Runway
roles.scope: Ship human-centered visual improvements to MIRRA, inspect 390 and 1440 layouts, verify all result and quiz states with screenshot readback.

roles.name: Acquisition and Retention
roles.system: Factory growth cycle + Fieldwork qualified distribution
roles.scope: Find qualified creator/community partners, analyze first answer, completion, return and invitations. No unconsented sends.

roles.name: Together and Circles Product
roles.scope: Improve two-person journeys, private sharing, invitation referrals, consent and future interest based circles without public sensitive profiling.

roles.name: Independent Release and Outcome Readback
roles.scope: Validate source PR/commit/CI/deploy and evidence of actual voluntary participants; separate source events, browsers and verified users.

benchmarks.name: Dimensional
benchmarks.observed_public_product_claim: Deep multidimensional profile and friends comparison
benchmarks.mirra_experiment: Profile retains detail and makes another person's perspective useful

benchmarks.name: Boo
benchmarks.observed_public_product_claim: Identity and interest driven discovery, opt in community
benchmarks.mirra_experiment: Connect on shared curiosity, not simplistic compatibility verdict

benchmarks.name: Paired
benchmarks.observed_public_product_claim: Daily conversation, question packs, two-person interaction
benchmarks.mirra_experiment: Joint answer reveal and meaningful recurring prompts

benchmarks.name: Partiful
benchmarks.observed_public_product_claim: One-link invitation without required app installation
benchmarks.mirra_experiment: Invite a guest who can participate before creating an account

benchmarks.name: How We Feel
benchmarks.observed_public_product_claim: Accessible emotional vocabulary, small reflective moments
benchmarks.mirra_experiment: A useful emotion check in that does not diagnose

benchmarks.name: Finch
benchmarks.mirra_experiment: Pleasant repeat participation without guilt or fake streak pressure

benchmarks.name: 16Personalities
benchmarks.observed_public_product_claim: Readable result narratives with personal relevance
benchmarks.mirra_experiment: Editorial story quality while distinguishing science from entertainment

benchmarks.name: International Personality Item Pool
benchmarks.observed_public_product_claim: Public domain factor markers and scoring information
benchmarks.mirra_experiment: Explain item scoring and limits, not clinical authority

workstreams.title: First answer conversion
workstreams.action: Track landing→first answer by source and reduce friction
workstreams.acceptance: At least 5 distinct opted-in adult volunteers answer Q1 and 3 complete; de-duplicate source evidence; never use bot visits as users

workstreams.title: MIRRA Together v2
workstreams.action: Joint answer reveal, richer conversation cards and guest invitations
workstreams.acceptance: Two real pairs complete both sides voluntarily; privacy and expired link behavior tested

workstreams.title: Editorial visual QA
workstreams.action: Create cohesive 2027 style, authentic portraits, premium typography and mobile first interactions
workstreams.acceptance: Real screenshots at 390 and 1440, below fold, no overflow; accessible keyboard/focus and source assets license checked

workstreams.title: Psychology scoring review
workstreams.action: Verify IPIP item keys and score descriptions against original sources
workstreams.acceptance: 50 items scoring and reverse keys tested; original exploratory quizzes clearly labeled and nonclinical

workstreams.title: First circle recruiting
workstreams.action: Research qualified volunteer testers and micro creators; write personalized relevant invitations
workstreams.acceptance: Five real voluntary feedback participants evidenced by actual submission/reply; no bulk cold outreach

workstreams.title: Signature portrait 2.0
workstreams.action: Printable social share visuals with participant chosen artwork and meaningful copy
workstreams.acceptance: Cross device screenshots, no third party image hotlink failures, shared link resolves at source

workstreams.title: Daily curiosity rotation
workstreams.action: Meaningful rotating prompts and history without punitive streaks
workstreams.acceptance: At least 2 real testers choose to return and complete second reflection

workstreams.title: Audience segment intelligence
workstreams.action: Track relevant opt in communities, psychology creators, couples educators and young professionals
workstreams.acceptance: Source URLs with date/persona/offer fit, not harvested addresses or fictional collaborations

workstreams.title: Interactive conversation stories
workstreams.action: Add branching scenarios for friendship and values with traceable results
workstreams.acceptance: No dead end, readable choices, mobile finish path and real tester feedback

workstreams.title: Content quality editorial audit
workstreams.action: Revise repetitive scenarios and ungrounded profile claims
workstreams.acceptance: Peer review of all user facing claims and 2 distinct test sessions

workstreams.title: Return and share metric integrity
workstreams.action: Exclude synthetic QA from acquisition; read actual daily funnel distinct browser vs people
workstreams.acceptance: Document exactly provider verified visits, answer events, returns, invited pairs, consent basis

workstreams.title: Social circles design pilot
workstreams.action: Small opt in interest circles, group questions, reporting and private by default
workstreams.acceptance: Pilot with real participants; opt in, report and block behavior tested before public profiles

workstreams.title: Mobile microinteractions
workstreams.action: Tactile answer states, responsive choice transitions and useful loading states
workstreams.acceptance: Reduced motion, 44px touch targets, 390/1440 test no regressions

workstreams.title: Personality profile continuity
workstreams.action: Explain growth across repeated assessments and journal when user chooses save
workstreams.acceptance: Cloud profile readback only for authenticated user; proper export/delete verified

workstreams.title: Public first-use SEO
workstreams.action: Original short experience pages, personalized share previews, sitemap and indexability
workstreams.acceptance: HTML OG metadata and accessible full experience at shared link; unique original editorial copy

workstreams.title: First 100 cohort learning
workstreams.action: Synthesize actual onboarding and feedback themes to prioritize next experiment
workstreams.acceptance: Backed by sourced consented feedback; classify assumptions separately from confirmed outcomes

research_segments.source: public creator sites with voluntary business contact
opt in founder and tester communities

loop_control.on_no_visitors: improve first value and source distribution with a single safe experiment
loop_control.on_no_first_answer: inspect share deep link, script, first screen and above fold CTA
loop_control.on_low_completion: audit question length, answer feedback, mobile rendering
loop_control.on_no_share: improve report usefulness and guest Together invitations
loop_control.on_no_return: test daily question relevance and follow up when consented

scope_default: Internal research/code/QA allowed; actual external outreach only on known lawful recipient and authorized channel; no paid ads, Stripe, public PII or irreversible actions.

synthetic_lab.cadence: every six hours within original MIRRA CI
synthetic_lab.purpose: scripted human-like browser scenarios, issue discovery and source evidence
synthetic_lab.company_os_handoff: M22 source-backed workstreams, no new agent queue
